import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.csv_exporter import export_csv
from src.json_exporter import export_json
from src.exporter import export_rows
from src.dispatcher import export

# Quoting, embedded newline, None and missing keys, non-ASCII
rows = [{'id': 1, 'name': 'A,"B"\nC'}, {'id': None, 'name': 'zebra'}, {'name': 'è'}]
assert export_csv(rows) == 'id,name\n1,"A,""B""\nC"\n,zebra\n,è\n'
assert export_json(rows) == '[{"id":"1","name":"A,\\"B\\"\\nC"},{"id":"","name":"zebra"},{"id":"","name":"è"}]'

# Generators / one-shot iterables are consumed once, inputs not mutated
assert export_csv(iter([{'id': 2, 'name': 'Bob'}])) == 'id,name\n2,Bob\n'
assert export_json(iter([{'id': 2, 'name': 'Bob'}])) == '[{"id":"2","name":"Bob"}]'
data = [{'id': 3, 'name': 'C'}]
export_rows(data, 'csv'); export_rows(iter([{'id': 9}]), 'json')
assert data == [{'id': 3, 'name': 'C'}]

# Empty input keeps header / empty JSON array
assert export_csv([]) == 'id,name\n'
assert export_json([]) == '[]'

# Non-string values are stringified; None and missing keys become ''
assert export_json([{'id': 1.5, 'name': False}, {'id': 2, 'name': None}]) == '[{"id":"1.5","name":"False"},{"id":"2","name":""}]'
assert export_csv([{'id': 2, 'name': None}]) == 'id,name\n2,\n'

# Extra keys ignored, order preserved
assert export_json([{'name': 'n', 'id': 1, 'extra': 'x'}, {'id': 0}]) == '[{"id":"1","name":"n"},{"id":"0","name":""}]'

# Wrappers and dispatcher agree with the shared entry point
sample = [{'id': 1, 'name': 'Alice'}]
assert export_csv(sample) == export_rows(sample, 'csv') == export(sample, 'csv')
assert export_json(sample) == export_rows(sample, 'json') == export(sample, 'json')

# Unsupported format raises ValueError everywhere
for fn in (export_rows, export):
    for fmt in ('xml', 'CSV', ''):
        try:
            fn([], fmt)
        except ValueError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError('expected ValueError for %r' % fmt)

print('exporter checks OK')
